description: Header file defining classes and interfaces for Android's Gralloc3 graphics buffer management, including mapper and allocator classes.

classes.name: Gralloc3Mapper
classes.description: Implements buffer management functions for Android's graphics system using the V3.0 mapper interface.

classes.name: Gralloc3Allocator
classes.description: Handles buffer allocation for Android graphics buffers, relying on a Gralloc3Mapper instance.

methods.name: isLoaded
methods.description: Checks if the mapper or allocator is loaded.

methods.name: importBuffer
methods.description: Imports a buffer from a raw handle.

methods.name: validateBufferSize
methods.description: Validates the size of a buffer.

methods.name: getTransportSize
methods.description: Retrieves transport size info for a buffer.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Locks a buffer with YCbCr info.

methods.name: isSupported
methods.description: Checks if a buffer configuration is supported.

methods.name: dumpDebugInfo
methods.description: Dumps debug information for the allocator.
